svg.title: The Kinsman, kneeling on a blood-stained altar, threatens a wineskin dressed as a baby with a knife; Mika, in an old woman's mask, holds out a bowl for its blood
svg.desc: Line drawing after the Apulian red-figure bell-krater Würzburg H 5697, side A; traced from photographs by ArchaiOptix (CC BY-SA 4.0), taken off the vase's curve, changed.
